motivation: Every retained deck automorphism is outer. Under GL3(F2)=PSL2(F7), it is implemented in PGL2(F7). The determinant-square-class twist of the adjoint action on traceless2x2 matrices gives a3-dimensional F7 representation in which outer involutions are rank-one reflections. This supplies the missing knot meridian geometry without an inner binary deck implementer.
test: Construct an explicit coefficient-group isomorphism, unique outer projective deck element and all knot meridian images. Verify involutivity, rank-one differences and all oriented Wirtinger relators; compute the complete admissible root-cocycle space over F7. Dimension>=4 with the existing four-seed upper presentation is sharp.
controls: Faithful projective coefficient group order168 with PGL automorphisms336; adjoint twist preserves the determinant quadratic form; every selected outer involution has one nonidentity eigenline; evaluate principal cocycles directly
boundary: Only these fixed PGL2(F7) reflection bases are tested. A miss is not an all-field exclusion. A hit needs separate exact matrix/rank and upper-presentation replay, knot identity and prior-family audit. No novelty or full MRC assertion.
